feature: A picked rounded shape is ringed round its box
summary: Pick a rounded rectangle and the accent ring is now the same near-square frame round its box that every other layer wears, as the mocks draw it, so it no longer reads as a blue border on the shape. The decision card shows both looks side by side.
setup: Photonz Probe, release Next, no switch changed from its default.

try.do: Press R and drag out a rectangle on a blank canvas.
Pull Corner Radius in the panel to about 70.
try.shotNote: Taken with the window behind another app: the accent can read a little paler than in front.

try.do: Press Command-plus twice to zoom in.
try.shotNote: Taken with the window behind another app: the accent can read a little paler than in front.

try.do: Look at the four corner handles: each sits on the ring, at the corner of the box a resize grabs.
For the old look, open Experiments and switch off The ring round a pick hugs its box.

evaluate: With the shape rounded right up, does the square frame still read as the selection rather than as standing off the shape?
Does the curved ring in the last picture look like a border drawn on the shape?
Do the corner handles feel attached to the frame in the first look and loose in the second?
rough: Which look stays is your call on the open card a-picked-rounded-shape-is-ringed-round-its-box-a-when-you-pick-a-rounded-rectangl; Next shows the mock's square frame until you answer.
Matches the mock's .sel-ring in shape: the frame hugs the box with a 2 point softening on screen at every zoom, for every kind of layer, ovals and arrows included.
Every picture is a real window capture, taken with the window behind another app.
